description_en: Queries the relationship between Anti-DDoS Origin instances and tags
description_zh: 查询资源（DDoS原生防护实例）和标签的对应关系
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource to query. Set the value to INSTANCE
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的资源的类型。取值固定为INSTANCE，表示实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用本接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query.

The ResourceId parameter and the key-value pair for the Tag parameter cannot be left empty at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的原生防护实例的ID列表。

ResourceId和Tag Key-Value对不能同时为空
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag to query.

The ResourceId parameter and the key-value pair for the Tag parameter cannot be left empty at the same time
fields.help_zh:
要查询的标签键。

ResourceId和Tag Key-Value对不能同时为空
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag to query.

The ResourceId parameter and the key-value pair for the Tag parameter cannot be left empty at the same time
fields.help_zh:
要查询的标签值。

ResourceId和Tag Key-Value对不能同时为空
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The key-value pair of the tag to query
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）
